ghx_salvage_claim.title: The Cost of a Good Recovery
ghx_salvage_claim.theme: An independent salvage crew balances a valuable recovery, a disputed claim and promises to the people doing the work. Reuse the finite quests A Hold Full of Knuckles, The Name on the Crate and The Price of Bringing It Back when applicable; do not generate duplicates or a second payout. The crew have their own financial pressures and disagreements. The player can join, negotiate a limited role, expose a dishonest sale or leave.
ghx_salvage_claim.surfacePremise: The Gilded Albatross can recover a valuable consignment, but finding it and being entitled to sell it are different problems.
ghx_salvage_claim.expectedConclusion: The actual recovered goods receive an informed, carried-out disposition and the crew’s agreed work is settled, or the venture ends with a specific known loss. Do not imply successful delivery from a promise or require an inevitable betrayal.
secrets: Reina guaranteed an expensive hull repair against her own share.
Sōji fears an attractive recovery will become a costly ownership dispute.
Kanna Enozaki can offer a shortcut whose advantage depends on what the parties actually know.

ghx_patient_island.title: The Island That Breathes
ghx_patient_island.theme: A peaceful giant animal has a small painful problem and a resting ground people find convenient. Use What the Shell Caught, A Patient Kind of Work and The Nesting Shelf for the real developments, not repeated generic care jobs. Observation, practical care and an actual change in traffic can each matter. Do not turn patience into automatic taming, a compulsory level-60 fight or a secret talking deity.
ghx_patient_island.surfacePremise: Mauruun’s uneasy shifts have become more frequent, and Mina wants to know why before someone provokes it.
ghx_patient_island.expectedConclusion: The identified irritation is relieved and a workable resting/landing arrangement is carried out, or the people involved explicitly choose a limited unresolved outcome. The turtle remains its own animal, not a free mount.
secrets: Old line pulls at a tender shell seam.
Makiho’s useful fishing approach overlaps the resting shelf.
